chapter_title_en: Stirrings Overseas: Remains in the Ghost Mist
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 445: Ghost Mist Remains and the Cultivator’s Fate
chapter_meta_description: Han Li, Fairy Ziling, and Ge Li traverse the Ghost Mist. A dead cultivator’s remains reveal that not even Core Formation guarantees survival in the Void Heaven Palace trails.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch.445: A Corpse in the Mist
og_description: Han Li finds the bones of a cultivator who failed the Void Heaven Palace trial decades ago. The lesson: even strong cultivators die alone in the Ghost Mist.
twitter_title: RMJI 445: One misstep and you become a cautionary tale in the Ghost Mist.
twitter_description: A dead Core-formation cultivator, a living mist, and a protagonist who treats every corpse as a tactical data point.

lore_anchors.definition: An animate undead mist that drains life force and traps souls, preventing reincarnation; any cultivator who dies in it becomes part of its horror.
An ancient floating jade palace that appears periodically; a major high-risk dungeon where cultivators compete for legendary treasures.
A rare and mysterious spirit beast said to have the power to suppress or devour evil spirits; the black-robed figure uses it to clear the Ghost Mist.
Han Li’s primary cultivation technique; its sword-shield projection allows him to use sword power without releasing the actual flying sword.
A variant of Divine Thunder Bamboo with gold lightning properties; highly effective against evil and ghostly entities.
A deceased cultivator with ice-attribute spiritual roots and a Fire-Repelling Robe; his Core-formation-level cultivation still could not save him in the Ghost Mist.
